title: [review] protected request with empty payload gets plain 4.00 instead of protected error
description: P2 RFC 8613 4.2.1. coap_dtn.c:122 and :239-241: for a verified OSCORE request, missing payload returns positive COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_BAD_REQUEST which the framework sends UNPROTECTED, while every other error path in the same handlers uses coap_oscore_respond_resource (protected). Conformant clients discard plain responses to protected requests -> silent retransmit loop. Fix: route the empty-payload error through coap_oscore_respond_resource(...,BAD_REQUEST,...) like the store-failure path.
